extensions.description: GitHub extension shorthands (e.g. 'github:user/repo#branch') or detailed metadata objects.

oneOf.description: Path to a folder (relative to forgeconfig.json) to scan for custom function definitions.
List of paths to folders (relative to forgeconfig.json) to scan for custom function definitions.

custom_colors.description: Custom hex color palette for function names (cycling or hashed).

constant_custom_colors.description: If enabled, custom colors are assigned consistently based on function name rather than a rotating pattern.

custom_color_text.description: Custom hex color for plain text and string content inside code blocks.

custom_color_time.description: Custom hex color for time literals (e.g. 10s, 5m, 2h).

custom_color_number.description: Custom hex color for numeric literals.

custom_color_separator.description: Custom hex color for semicolon argument separators (;).

custom_color_dollar.description: Custom hex color for the dollar sign ($) prefix.

custom_color_modifier.description: Custom hex color for operator/modifier characters (e.g. !, #, ?).

custom_color_boolean.description: Custom hex color for boolean literals (true, false).

semantic_decorations.description: If enabled, both theme-driven semantic tokens and custom text decorations will be active simultaneously.
